notes: Merged from two successful portal queries: 2010/2011-2019/2020 and 2020/2021-2025/2026; overlap is absent.
Only the 2013/2014–2019/2020 seasons were returned in the first period; no rows were invented for earlier years.
Current boundary mode used for both queries, so the selected modern geometry is the portal's current area boundaries.
Values are kept as displayed by the source, including decimal commas and percent signs.
fallda_totalt is the reported number of shot moose. avskjutningsmal_totalt is the target and must not be confused with actual shot count.
